data.name: Ellsworth
data.long_meaning: The name Ellsworth comes from Old English words ‘Elf’ meaning ‘elf’ or ‘stranger’ and ‘worth’ meaning ‘fort’ or ‘enclosure’. The name has been used since the Middle Ages and was popularized in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Ellsworth can be seen as a symbol of protection, strength, and otherworldliness.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection and otherworldliness.
data.numerology_meaning: Expressive, artistic, and emotional, but can also be moody and sensitive. They are highly intuitive, sensitive, and spiritual, able to sense the needs of others and respond with compassion.

in_hebrew.name: אלסוורת'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלסוורת' הוא שם שמקורו באנגלית ומורכב מ'אל' שפירושו אלוהים ו'סוורת' שפירושו חוזק או עוצמה, לכן ניתן לפרש את השם אלסוורת' כ'אלוהים הוא החוזק שלי' או 'חוזק אלוהים', שם זה משקף את האמונה והתלות באלוהים כמקור הכוח והעוצמה.

in_greek.name: Ελσουορθ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελσουορθ προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και συντίθεται από το 'El' που σημαίνει Θεός και το 'sworth' που σημαίνει δύναμη ή ισχύς, επομένως το Ελσουορθ μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'Ο Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου' ή 'Η δύναμη του Θεού', αντανακλώντας την πίστη και την εξάρτηση από τον Θεό ως πηγή δύναμης και ισχύος.

in_latin.name: Ellsworth
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ellsworth ex lingua anglica derivatum est et componitur ex 'El' quod significat Deum et 'sworth' quod significat fortitudinem seu potentiam, ergo Ellsworth interpretari potest ut 'Deus est mea fortitudo' vel 'Fortitudo Dei', reflectens fidem et dependentiam a Deo ut fonte virium et potentiae.

in_english.name: Ellsworth
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ellsworth originates from English and is composed of 'El', meaning God, and 'sworth', meaning strength or power. It can be interpreted as 'God is my strength' or 'God's strength'. This name reflects the belief in and reliance on God as the source of power and strength. Historically, it has been used in Christian traditions to signify one's faith and dependence on divine power.

Ellsworth can be seen as a symbol of the pioneer spirit, representing the hardiness and determination required to settle new lands.
